build_metadata.crt_math_finding: Default w64devkit links msvcrt.dll + libmingwex.a, where log1p() falls back to legacy x87 fyl2x microcode (4 fyl2x ops, ~+210ms overhead in assembly/objective loops). The teacher's original stochastic_dca.exe was built with WinLibs MinGW-w64 UCRT GCC 16.2.0 linking Windows api-ms-win-crt-math-l1-1-0.dll (0 fyl2x ops). Creating a 6-symbol pure-math import library (log1p, log, sin, cos, acos, sqrt -> api-ms-win-crt-math-l1-1-0.dll) with dlltool eliminates x87 stalls cleanly with zero C++ source changes, improving Ryzen 5 native runtime from ~0.59s to ~0.38s (1.55x-1.66x).
